renewal_failure_transition: If replacement creation fails by expiry, transition status to blocked_expired and record the failure in blockers; do not continue cycles under the expired job.
last_cycle_summary: Cycle 9 delivered the M1 pause/resume slice through PR #15, squash-merged as 9291f52 after both required CI runs passed on both commits. Versioned pause_process/resume_process requests SIGSTOP/SIGCONT the run's whole process group (spec adapter API pause(runId)/resume(runId)); the registry value became RunControl {cancelled, paused, pgid} and Swift IPCClient gained pauseProcess/resumeProcess mirroring cancelProcess. The timeout deadline deliberately keeps ticking while paused. Implemented by a Codex gpt-5.6-sol worker (high effort) in a four-file allowlist; the orchestrator relocated its Swift real-backend test into the existing integration harness after the worker correctly flagged a wrong allowlist path rather than exceeding its fence. Independent Codex sol review found 1 blocker/1 major/3 minor: the SeqCst handshake ordered memory but not signals (a stalled post-spawn SIGSTOP could land after a resume) and control requests could signal a reaped, reusable pgid. Fixed pre-merge by a second sol worker: all {pgid, paused} transitions and their signals now serialize under the registry mutex, and terminal branches retire the published pgid before reaping; test hardening for zombie states and slow CI. Runtime demo: grandchild S-to-T 0.00s after pause, back to S on resume, group dead 0.01s after cancel. M1 remains active and incomplete for PTYs, waiting-input detection and run stdin, redaction/metadata, durable state, budget expiry, and temporary/worktree cleanup.
